notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at VFS New Delhi
notes.title: Visa may miss your flight
notes.text: INSEAD told Fontainebleau starters this morning that the French visa can take up to eight weeks, and holiday volumes will stretch it. Eight weeks from Tuesday lands after your 3 January flight. - Worth raising the January start at the counter and with visas.fb@insead.edu.

notes.itemTitle: [NEWS] Pin down the MBB recruiting calendar for 2027
notes.title: CDC posted open roles
notes.text: The CDC newsletter this morning links a list of internship and full-time roles already open, refreshed weekly. Kraft Heinz is also running its Ketchup Invitational, with a presentation on 12 November and a route to a summer internship in Amsterdam. - The Kraft Heinz route fits your consumer target.
